shadows.name: sundial-paper
shadows.purpose: 唯一承载主图形的纸面。

motion.name: selection
motion.purpose: 选择后同步更新影针、行和说明；减少动画不影响结果。

components.name: Date Stamp
components.html: 八月二十九日 · 星期六
components.css: .ds-date-stamp { display:inline-block; padding:12px 18px; color:#fff9ed; background:#22352c; font:700 15px sans-serif; letter-spacing:.8px; }

components.name: Rhythm Row
components.css: .ds-rhythm-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:70px 1fr auto; width:100%; align-items:center; padding:16px 18px; border:1px solid rgba(34,53,44,.28); color:#22352c; background:transparent; text-align:left; } .ds-rhythm-row b { color:#d99b18; } .ds-rhythm-row:hover { border-color:#22352c; } .ds-rhythm-row:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #d99b18; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Selected Rhythm Row
components.css: .ds-rhythm-selected { display:grid; grid-template-columns:70px 1fr auto; width:100%; align-items:center; padding:16px 18px; border:0; color:#fff9ed; background:#22352c; text-align:left; } .ds-rhythm-selected:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #d99b18; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Sundial Panel
components.description: 承载日晷的唯一抬升纸面。
components.css: .ds-sundial { aspect-ratio:1.18; padding:28px; color:#22352c; background:#fff9ed; border:1px solid rgba(34,53,44,.18); box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(34,53,44,.12); } .ds-sundial div { width:80%; aspect-ratio:2; margin:28% auto 0; border:2px solid #d99b18; border-bottom-color:#d99b18; border-radius:999px 999px 0 0; }

components.name: Selected Entry
components.description: 当前节奏的时间、标题和提示。
components.html: 09:00 · 第一段专注关闭消息提醒，只处理需要完整上下文的任务。
components.css: .ds-selected-entry { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; padding:24px 26px; color:#fff9ed; background:#22352c; font-family:sans-serif; } .ds-selected-entry strong { font-size:24px; } @media(max-width:600px){.ds-selected-entry{flex-direction:column;}}

narrative.overview: 界面像一张放在桌面的日照记录。半圆日晷是唯一主图形，五个时间落点和底部说明共同响应选择。

rules.name: One Selection Rule
rules.body: 同一时刻只有一个节奏条使用实心植物墨。

dos: Do 让日晷影针、选中行和底部说明由同一数据驱动。
Do 保持日期和测试数据固定。
donts: Don't 加入生产力仪表盘组件。
Don't 把这套 UI 复用到其他项目。
